caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object in the upper left portion, which is a branding iron featuring a twisted and circular design at the end, forming the letters "O" and "X." The branding iron is rendered in shades of brown and gray, indicating a metallic texture with subtle highlights and shadows for depth. Attached to the branding end is a long straight handle that terminates in a curled hook, suggesting it is made of a single piece of metal. Below and to the right of the branding iron are two large, hand-drawn letters in a light reddish-brown color: "O" and "X," mimicking the shape of the branding end of the iron. The objects are set against an off-white background. In the bottom left corner, the name "Elizabeth Johnson" appears in small black text.
title: Branding Iron
